decisions.decision: Keep PRJ-* consumer artifacts separate from PROJ-* canonical legal projections.
decisions.reason: Prevents semantic collision and preserves backward compatibility.

decisions.decision: Represent uncertainty as first-class result states.
decisions.reason: Prevents fabricated legal conclusions when facts or interpretation are insufficient.

decisions.decision: Allow only enumerated pure operations in projection definitions.
decisions.reason: Supports determinism, auditability and later sandboxed execution.
